Componentwise purity after completion and ordinary zero-Hessian current equivalence against every compact complementary (n-1,n-1) form on actual good separated strict boundaryless pure n-dimensional X, n>=1. Wild and mixed finite stages, singularities, nilpotents and actual Artinian lengths retained. General transcendental scalar extension, arbitrary curve-map pullback, two-sign ordinary regularization and classical recognition are not claimed.
